subject: DATE-OF-INTEGER function
notes: The eight-digit form is pinned by every PIC 9(8) receiver; r2's three COMPONENTS are read back out of 19950215 by INVERTING §15.46.3 r1's composition of this same form, '(YYYY * 10,000) + (MM * 100) + DD' over the fields §15.5.3 names — YYYY = INTEGER(D8/10000) = 1995, MM = INTEGER(MOD(D8,10000)/100) = 2, DD = MOD(D8,100) = 15. The anchor is NOT §15.23.4 r1: that clause's argument-1 is DATE-TO-YYYYMMDD's six-digit YYmmdd (§15.23.1, capped below 1000000 by §15.23.3 r1), where INTEGER(argument-1/10000) yields a two-digit YY — a real clause answering a different question, corrected in the fixer pass. The 29 February lines additionally pin that MM/DD are a real month and day rather than a positional accident.
